svg.aria-label: AgentRQ YOLO mode: claude asks to run go test and waits, so you flip the task's YOLO toggle instead of answering. That call and every one after it is auto-allowed, edits and test runs land in the Trajectory view without a single wait, and 48 tests pass. You open the last call to see it was auto-allowed, turn YOLO off again, and the agents celebrate.
